title: SAML onboarding: trust-anchor rotation & offline metadata bundle support in setup wizard
creator: Monica Vazquez
description: Add two capabilities to the SAML 2.0 setup wizard: (1) a first-class flow for rotating and validating trust anchors/certificates, and (2) an offline metadata bundle upload option for VPC/on-prem customers where live metadata fetching is blocked. The goal is to reduce failed SSO setups, harden certificate handling (chain validation, expiry/rotation UX), and produce rich audit events for every exchange and admin action.
technical_decisions: Wizard will validate uploaded metadata bundle via schema + signature verification against provided certs rather than relying solely on HTTP fetch.
Adopt RFC-compliant X509 chain validation with configurable trust anchors and a 5 minute clock skew allowance; report aging certs as warnings not hard failures unless expired.
Store SAML private keys and rotation secrets in customer KMS for Private deployments; hosted accounts will use Redwood-managed KMS with HSM-backed keys where required by contract.
Introduce immutable fingerprint artifacts for manual verification if automatic validation fails; fingerprints are surfaced in the wizard and written to audit logs.
Audit events emitted for: metadata upload, metadata fetch attempts, validation success/failure, trust-anchor rotation start/finish, admin rollback actions.
Only users with 'org-admin' RBAC role can perform trust-anchor rotations; create a 'sso.modify' scoped permission for future RBAC v2 integration.
acceptance_criteria: Wizard allows uploading a ZIP containing entity descriptor(s), certificates, and optional federation metadata and validates them locally.
Validation checks include XML schema, signature verification, cert chain validation, entityID normalization, and time-window checks.
When metadata fetch fails due to network/no egress, wizard surfaces a clear offline-bundle path with examples and stores the bundle hash in config.
Rotation flow allows previewing a new trust anchor, runs synthetic AuthnRequest/Response against a test IdP URL (or offline assertion tester), and requires explicit admin confirmation.
All admin actions emit structured audit events with operator, timestamp, operation, before/after hashes, and optional related PR/incident link.
End-to-end automated tests (unit + e2e) and a manual QA checklist pass in staging before release.
test_plan: Unit tests for schema and signature validation code paths (edge cases: multiple signatures, enveloped vs detached).
Integration test: upload metadata bundle with a three-level cert chain and expired intermediate to verify warning behavior.
E2E: run setup wizard in private-vpc test tenant where outgoing HTTP is blocked; confirm offline bundle flow succeeds and audit events appear in the Console.
Security test: ensure only users with sso.modify can rotate trust anchor; attempt rotation as non-admin and expect 403 and an audit log.
Chaos: simulate partial rotation failure and verify rollback path restores previous trust anchor and emits a rollback audit event.
